title: Blood Donation Eligibility Countdown
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`community:shift`), donations (`community:donation`), mutual-aid requests (`community:mutualaid`), service ops (`community:impact`).
app: Community-service telemetry — food-bank shift logs, blood-donation records, and mutual-aid request maps — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:donation donor_name=* eligible_again_epoch=* active=*
| eval days_left=round((eligible_again_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where active="yes"
| table donor_name donation_type days_left
| sort days_left
description: Lists open donor records with time remaining for blood-donation planning.
value: Time-left monitoring helps prevent quiet deadline misses across the operational details that support blood-donation planning.
implementation: Store an expiry timestamp on `community:donation` events and filter for open or unfinished donor records.
visualization: Table of open donor records sorted by time remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which donor records are about to run out of time so you can deal with them before blood-donation planning slips.
